source: Fixed public GitHub Releases: Z-YO-YI/coolapk-for-windows; stable Windows x64 NSIS installer
automaticActions: Startup checks only; downloads and confirmed installation are manual; never install on ordinary quit
integrity: Real electron-updater SHA512 download validation and independent validation before marking downloaded and before installation; corrupt cache is cleared for retry
credentials: Updater uses a separate nonpersistent Electron partition; synthetic native test observed no Cookie or Authorization headers
limitations: Native update tests use real transport/library with synthetic loopback bytes and record installer launch without installing. The first published 0.5.0 has no newer real release to test upgrading to. 0.4.0 needs one initial manual installation; portable updates migrate to the installed distribution.
